_comment: Pinned toolchain for this repo's evidence, CHECKED (not merely recorded)
before any PVT point is simulated. Ported from gf180-comparator/sim/
toolchain.json -- the pins themselves are re-derived against this host's
pdk_version       the open_pdks revision the gf180mcu models must come
from, as the verbatim first line of the variant
EXACT match required, because the revision IS the
device models: a different one silently yields
numbers no other record under sim/ is comparable
with. This is the revision the ciel store on the
reference host has enabled (the install sim/pdk.json
resolves to via its prepended ~/.ciel search root),
Remove the key to disable the check (not recommended).
ngspice_min_major floor, not an exact match -- newer ngspice is allowed
and recorded; older is refused. The workflow builds
python_min        floor, as 'major.minor'. Harness is stdlib-only.
